_why:
#33 — `DEFAULT_REGISTRY` is RELATIVE and nothing resolves it, so two byte-identical invocations from two directories in ONE repo wrote two different files and echoed the same token (`registry=.h-mad/wires.jsonl` both times). HemaSuite carries two live registries that differ because of it.

The second mutation is the load-bearing one and it guards a REFUSAL. Resolving the default against the git root is the fix that suggests itself and it re-creates J49: `_registry_base_path`'s docstring records a sub-project verify returning `FAIL undeclared_removals=5` where the truth was `PASS registered=23 verified=23`, because it compared one project's registry against another's. A nested registry is a SUPPORTED configuration, so the write must still land beside the caller. The defect was never 'the default points at the wrong file' — it is that WHICH file was used is invisible.

mutations.name: the-token-echoes-the-relative-default-again
mutations._mechanism: Restores the defect exactly: two runs that wrote different files print the same line, so no transcript can say which registry was touched.

mutations.name: the-default-is-relocated-to-the-git-root
mutations._mechanism: THE forbidden fix, and the reason this row is closed with a warning rather than a relocation. J49 exactly: a sub-project's registration lands in the ROOT registry, two intentionally separate registries are consolidated, and cross-project comparison returns invented removals. Must fail the J49 regression guard.

mutations.name: the-ambiguity-is-never-warned
mutations._mechanism: The visibility half. Without it an operator in a nested project has no signal that a second registry exists and that their cwd chose between them.
mutations.find:
if at_root == used or not at_root.exists():
        return str(used), None

mutations.name: the-ambiguity-warning-fires-on-every-run
mutations._mechanism: The over-correction. A warning on the ordinary single-project case is noise, and noise is how a real warning stops being read — the same reason every `h_mad_precheck_doc.py` detector filed hard on first cut had to be demoted.
mutations.find: if at_root == used or not at_root.exists():
